idea: Notes and PYQ papers for my college, sold to juniors before exams. I have about 8,000 rupees saved.

strategist.problem: First and second-year students face a 'preparation vacuum' in the 2 weeks before exams when they have access to generic university syllabi but lack the specific, high-yield notes and Previous Year Questions (PYQs) that actually determine pass/fail outcomes, forcing them to rely on unreliable, fragmented, and often expensive informal networks of seniors.
strategist.target_customer: First and second-year undergraduate students at [Specific College Name] who are actively searching for 'PYQs' or 'notes' in their class WhatsApp groups and are willing to pay a small premium for a curated, verified, and easily accessible bundle to reduce their study anxiety and time spent hunting for materials.
strategist.mission: To provide first and second-year students with a single, verified, and affordable bundle of high-yield notes and PYQs for their core subjects, eliminating the time and uncertainty of sourcing study materials from unreliable peer networks.

competitors.name: Informal senior networks (WhatsApp/Telegram groups)
competitors.differentiator: We offer a curated, verified, and structured bundle that saves students 3-5 hours of sifting through outdated, broken, or irrelevant files shared by seniors who may not have actually used them to pass.

competitors.name: Local campus photocopy shops
competitors.differentiator: We provide a digital-first, instantly accessible product that is 50-70% cheaper than the per-page cost of photocopying, with the added benefit of searchable text and no physical storage burden.

competitors.name: Generic online marketplaces (e.g., PDFs on Telegram channels)
competitors.differentiator: We offer subject-specific, college-specific content that is verified for accuracy and relevance to the current syllabus, unlike generic online channels that often contain outdated or incorrect information.

scope_cuts: Building a custom web app or mobile app: We will use a simple, low-cost digital delivery method (e.g., a Notion page, a Google Drive folder, or a simple PDF bundle) to avoid development costs and complexity, focusing entirely on content curation and delivery.

Creating original, from-scratch notes for every subject: We will curate and verify the best existing notes from top-performing seniors and official university materials, rather than spending 15 hours/week writing new content, which is a high-cost, low-ROI activity for a bootstrapped student.

Offering a subscription model or multi-semester access: We will sell one-time, per-subject bundles for the current exam cycle to simplify the sales process, reduce customer support burden, and align with the urgent, short-term nature of exam preparation.

stack.name: WhatsApp Business
stack.why: Primary storefront and order management channel where target customers already reside, enabling direct UPI payment links and file delivery without a website.

stack.name: Razorpay Payment Links
stack.why: Instant, no-code UPI and card payment collection with automatic invoice generation, eliminating the need for a custom checkout page.

stack.name: Google Drive
stack.why: Free, reliable backend for storing and sharing large PDF bundles with shareable links that expire after 7 days to prevent piracy.

stack.name: Canva
stack.why: Designs professional, branded PDF covers and WhatsApp catalog images to make the digital product look premium and trustworthy.

ai_tools.name: Claude Code
ai_tools.why: Automates the formatting and merging of raw senior notes into clean, searchable PDFs, reducing 15 hours of manual editing to 2 hours.

ai_tools.name: ChatGPT
ai_tools.why: Generates subject-specific study guides and exam tips to add value to the PYQ bundles without writing from scratch.

mvp_features: Subject Bundle 1: 'Maths & Physics PYQs + High-Yield Notes' for 1st Year, 50-page PDF, verified against 2023-2025 university papers.
Subject Bundle 2: 'Core Engineering/Commerce Notes + 10-Year PYQs' for 2nd Year, 60-page PDF, includes answer keys and examiner insights.

Manual Instant Delivery: Founder manually sends the Google Drive link within 10 minutes of payment confirmation, using WhatsApp Business Quick Replies for standard FAQs to ensure sub-5-minute response times without API costs.
first_10_steps: Identify 3 top-performing seniors from the previous year and request their raw notes and PYQs in exchange for a 50% revenue share on the first 10 sales.
Use Claude Code to merge, format, and verify the raw notes into two clean, 50-60 page PDF bundles for the most critical 1st and 2nd-year subjects.
Design a professional 3-page PDF cover and a 4-image WhatsApp catalog carousel using Canva Free, highlighting 'Verified by Toppers' and 'Instant Access'.
Create a Razorpay Payment Link for ₹99 per bundle, setting the description to 'Instant PDF Delivery via WhatsApp' and enabling UPI as the primary method.
Set up 5 WhatsApp Business Quick Replies for common questions (e.g., 'How do I access the file?', 'Is this for the current syllabus?') to reduce manual typing time by 50%.
Post the catalog and payment link in 5 class WhatsApp groups and 2 hostel groups, offering a ₹20 discount for the first 5 students who pay before 5 PM.
Manually send the Google Drive link to each paying student via WhatsApp within 10 minutes of payment, asking for a 1-sentence testimonial in return.
Collect 5 testimonials and screenshot them, adding them to the WhatsApp catalog images to build social proof for the next 20 sales.
Reach out to 2 college club WhatsApp groups to offer a 10% discount code for their members, expanding the reach beyond immediate class batches.
Monitor the 7-day expiry of Google Drive links and manually re-share the link if a student reports an issue, ensuring zero support friction.

revenue_targets.notes: Initial launch in 5 class groups and 2 hostel groups.
Expansion to 2 college club groups with discount codes.
Reinvested ₹500 into Instagram Story ads for geolocation targeting.

key_assumptions: Students are willing to pay ₹99 for a verified, curated bundle to save 3-5 hours of sourcing time.
Delivery cost is estimated at ₹25 per customer to reflect 10-15 minutes of manual WhatsApp support, link management, and refund handling.
Monthly burn is capped at ₹500 to cover minimal marketing costs, keeping runway high.
Conversion rate from WhatsApp groups to paid customers is estimated at 2-5% during exam weeks.

channels.name: Campus WhatsApp Group Seeding
channels.tactic: Post a 150-word value proposition + free 5-page sample PDF link in 7 specific class/hostel WhatsApp groups (3 first-year, 2 second-year, 2 hostel) every Monday and Thursday at 7 PM. Reply to every 'interested' or 'price?' comment within 10 minutes with a direct UPI link.

channels.name: Hostel WhatsApp Group Takeover
channels.tactic: Partner with 2 hostel floor representatives (one per year) to share a personalized 2-sentence recommendation and the free 10-question PYQ sample link in their specific floor WhatsApp groups (approx. 50-80 members each) on Day 1 and Day 14 of the month. Provide the floor rep with a pre-written script and a ₹50 UPI tip for their time.

first_10_customers: Identify 5 top-performing seniors (top 10% of last semester) in your department and ask them to forward a 5-page sample of your curated notes to their juniors' WhatsApp groups in exchange for a free copy of the bundle.

Walk into the 3 most crowded first-year class sections during a 10-minute break, introduce yourself as a senior who just passed, and offer a free 10-question PYQ sample on the spot to anyone who raises their hand.

DM 20 first-year students who recently posted 'PYQs' or 'notes' in public college Instagram comments or LinkedIn posts, offering a free sample PDF in exchange for their feedback and a UPI link if they want the full bundle.
Ask 2 hostel floor representatives to share your WhatsApp status update in their personal stories and post the sample link in their floor groups, tagging the hostel group.

Create a 'Founders Circle' WhatsApp group with 10 batchmates who are also preparing for exams; offer them the bundle at ₹49 (half price) in exchange for them sharing their experience in 3 other class groups.

Stand near the campus library exit during peak exam-prep hours (4-6 PM) for 2 hours, hand out 20 printed QR code cards to students leaving the library, and explain the 50-page verified bundle in 30 seconds.
growth.cold_message: Hey [Name], I noticed you're in the [Subject] group. I've curated a 50-page verified PDF with 10-year PYQs and high-yield notes for [College Name] exams. Here's a free 5-page sample: [Link]. If it helps, the full bundle is ₹99 via UPI: [Link].

objections.objection: ₹99 is too expensive for a PDF; I can get it for free on Telegram.
objections.response: Free Telegram PDFs are often outdated or from different colleges. My bundle is verified against this year's syllabus and includes answer keys, saving you 3-5 hours of sifting through broken files. If it doesn't help you pass, I'll refund you within 24 hours.

objections.objection: I don't have time to study from a new PDF; I'll just use my own notes.
objections.response: You don't need to study from scratch. The PDF is a 50-page high-yield summary and PYQ bank, not a textbook. Use it as a 2-hour revision checklist before the exam. It's designed to be read in one sitting.

critic.verdict: The plan is highly viable and perfectly aligned with the bootstrapped, campus-first constraints. It correctly identifies that the 'product' is curation and trust, not software development, which keeps costs near zero. The timeline and pricing are realistic for the Indian student market, leveraging existing social channels for distribution.
critic.biggest_risk: The primary risk is content quality and copyright: if the 'verified' notes from seniors are illegible, outdated, or incomplete, the 24-hour refund promise will lead to chargebacks and reputation damage in the tight campus community, killing the business before it scales.
